evidence.title: How Much Regularization Survives Averaging? Update Masking in Federated Learning

summary: Researchers analyzed how much regularization survives the model averaging process inherent to federated learning and proposed an update-masking scheme to preserve it. Their experiments demonstrate that selective masking can retain regularization benefits while maintaining communication efficiency.
title: Study Evaluates Effectiveness of Regularization and Update Masking in Federated Learning
